onboarding_language_subtitle: Before we start, I need to know which language to speak to you in.
onboarding_gender_title: One quick thing before we continue…
onboarding_gender_subtitle: How should I refer to you?
onboarding_name_title: So, what should I call you?
onboarding_name_hint: Little tip: using the nickname Tonton Jiee usually calls you might make a few surprises even more personal. 😉
home_welcome_body:
Hi {player_name}, so happy to see you again! ✨

This is your game.

Tonton Jiee made it just for you.

There will be words to uncover, a few traps, choices to make…

and a few surprises you probably won't see coming. 😌
level_failure_message: Nope. 😏 But you weren't far off.
secret_subtitle: Collect 10 fragments to reveal your message
secret_choose_desc: All 10 cards in this set hide the same fragment of your message. Follow your intuition!
secret_tip: 💡 Every choice is a good one. What matters is the one that speaks to you. 💜
reward_message_affectionate_0:
{player_name},

you just finished this chapter…

and I hope you already know one thing:

you're probably far more capable than you give yourself credit for.

Keep going. There's more waiting for you. ❤️

I'm proud of you.

you matter.

reward_message_warm_0:

rewards_empty:
No rewards unlocked yet.

Finish a full chapter (10 levels) to unlock one.
howto_step_1: 1. Pick a theme from the categories shown. Every level starts with this choice.
howto_step_2: 2. A hint appears, with scrambled letters at the bottom. Tap the letters in order to spell out the word.
howto_step_3: 3. Placed a letter wrong? Tap it directly in its slot to remove just that one — nothing else moves. The next letter you tap will land in that spot.
howto_step_4: 4. Some letters are already placed for you, in gold: a small boost on longer words.
howto_step_5: 5. Stuck? The lightbulb 💡 at the bottom reveals one extra letter, once per level. Finish 10 levels to unlock a surprise… but that's all we'll say. 😌
